topic: Digging the grave of my skills: Hollywood creatives training AI to do their jobs
headline: Will AI Replace Hollywood Creatives?
caption: As a full stack engineer, I see parallels in how AI is being trained across industries. When creators teach machines to do their jobs, it raises questions about job security and skill relevance. It’s exciting but also concerning to think about where this trend is heading. Instead of fearing AI, maybe we should focus on how to leverage it to enhance our work without losing the human touch. Keep learning, stay adaptable, and remember that technology should augment, not replace. 🔧 #AI #FullStack #TechTrends #CodingLife
